# One API Well-Known LLM Instructions

Canonical instructions are available at https://oneapi.laisky.com/llms.txt.

Agents should use the OpenAPI spec at https://oneapi.laisky.com/openapi.json, authenticate `/v1/*` and `/mcp` calls with `Authorization: Bearer <relay-api-key>`, and avoid exposing relay API keys in logs, prompts, or URLs.
